thread:
mike (platform): Heads up — noticed a carveout/subnet rebalance in eu-west that didn't update keystore affinity. We got a cascade: keystore proxy QPS spike, some GPU nodes failing `keystore.attach` during warmup (507s), and warm-pool drains. Can someone triage? Logs: https://logs.internal/r/ztf4

sara (infra): Yep, I see the hotspot. agent pinned keystore affinity to the old eu subnet CIDR (10.12.0.0/20) so new nodes in the carved range are all hitting the same proxy set. Short term we can rebalance affinity or bump ephemeral quota for that subnet.

chris (sre): Also seeing a drop in CloudTrail ingestion for those nodes — audit events from instance role assume are missing for ~7m. Likely an NACL rule accidentally blocking 443 to the keystore-proxy ENIs during the carveout.

tara (sec): We can't blanket-relax egress without a compliance note. Options: A) short-lived carveout quota bump + targeted flowlog sampling to preserve audit fidelity, or B) migrate traffic via privatelink/NLB (compliant) which is longer. What's the immediate risk?

mike (platform): Immediate risk = more failed warmups + throttled launch capacity for dedicated pools. I prefer option A to stabilize, then schedule B as the durable fix. Cost: rough estimate for A is ~$2k/week while hot.

deploy-bot: patch-keystore-affinity v1.2 -> canary start on eu-west-1 (5 nodes). Rolling update job: #9832.

sara (infra): I'll own the short-term. Plan: 1) increase keystore ephemeral quota for carved subnet to 2000; 2) update agent affinity config to use /22 affinity window (reduces hotspots); 3) bump flowlogs sampling to 100% for 12h for full audit capture; 4) monitor attach errors and rollback if >5% error. PR will reference this thread.

sara (infra): Quick snippet I'll run for verification:
```bash
# check subnet CIDR mapping to keystore-proxy ENIs
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=subnet-0abc123" --query 'Reservations[*].Instances[*].[InstanceId,PrivateIpAddress]'
```

chris (sre): Add a temp alert: `keystore.attach.errors > 5% over 5m -> page oncall`. Also tag cost center `infra-provisioning` so finance can triage spend.

tara (sec): I'll review the PR for IAM/role boundary checks — ensure cross-account role assumptions to the proxy still include the required conditions. If we do a quota bump, add a scoped exception and an audit ticket.

mike (platform): Thanks — scheduling a 2h maintenance window starting in 30m to apply the change and watch. Post updates here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary update succeeded on 5 nodes, 0/5 failures reported. Job #9832 -> status: SUCCESS.

sara (infra): I've opened PR #4579 with the affinity change, quota bump request, and flowlog sampling toggle. Will start the quota request now.

chris (sre): I'll add the alert and a short runbook entry: how to rollback affinity -> revert agent config and scale down keystore ephemeral quota.

tara (sec): Putting a temporary compliance exception ticket in Jira -> COMP-312, retention and audit scope included. I'll close once PL migration plan is gated.

mike (platform): Nice work. After we stabilize, let's schedule a follow-up for privatelink migration and cost estimate.

sara (infra): Follow-up: monitoring shows attach errors back to baseline, flowlogs captured the missing events. Will keep sampling at 100% for 6h then drop to 10% while we plan PL.

chris (sre): Confirmed — CloudTrail re-ingest completed, no gaps beyond the 7m window. Closing incident if nothing else crops up.

mike (platform): Closing loop: maintenance window ended, nodes are healthy, cost tag applied. Thanks all.
